# ADR-002: Already migrated to YAML frontmatter

## Status

accepted

## Context

This ADR already has frontmatter and should NOT be flagged by EXT-003.

## Decision

Keep YAML frontmatter as the only supported metadata surface (ADR 003 § MD-002).

## Consequences

EXT-003's advisory must list ADR-001 only, not this one.
